subject: biology
title: Transport and Digestion
welcome_lead: Follow blood and food on their journeys through the circulatory and digestive systems.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure on the circulatory and digestive body systems.
final_note: You can now trace how blood circulates and how food is broken down inside you.

concepts.def: Heart and vessels that carry blood around.
Vessel carrying blood away from the heart.
Vessel carrying blood back to the heart.

walkthroughs.body_html: The heart pumps blood around the body. Arteries carry blood away, veins return it, and tiny capillaries reach every cell to deliver oxygen and food.
Food goes mouth → oesophagus → stomach → small intestine → large intestine. The small intestine absorbs digested nutrients into the blood.
The digestive system breaks down food. The circulatory system carries it to every cell where mitochondria use it for energy. Systems always depend on each other.
